known_native_divergences: LibreOffice uses native TYPE code 8 for a reference to a formula number and for a formula logical; direct TYPE(TRUE()) returns 1 under this host.
LibreOffice rejects numeric Text and Empty inputs for ISEVEN/ISODD even though the selected contract converts them.
LibreOffice rejects omitted NUMBERVALUE separators under this host although the contract default is decimal "." and group ",".
LibreOffice accepts VALUE("1 1/100") and VALUE("3/4") despite the selected required mixed-fraction grammar.
LibreOffice rejects several required en_US date forms under C.UTF-8 and accepts VALUE("24:00")/VALUE("1899-12-29") outside the selected domain.
LibreOffice applies ordinary coercion to VALUE(Number/Logical) where the contract returns #VALUE!.
